suite.description: 24 original deterministic arithmetic, logic, JSON, instruction, retrieval and code-output tasks. Not IQ, not an official leaderboard; no code execution or subjective judge.

tasks.prompt: Compute 347 + 586. Reply with only the integer.
Compute 84 * 17. Reply with only the integer.
Compute (125 - 37) * 6. Reply with only the integer.
What is three eighths of 240? Reply with only the integer.
All norks are tavs. No tav is a mip. Can any nork be a mip? Reply exactly YES or NO.
Four people stand in a line. Ava is before Bex, Bex before Cy, and Dax after Cy. Who is second? Reply with only the name.

A prize is in exactly one of RED, BLUE, GREEN. Exactly one label is true. RED says 'the prize is in BLUE'. BLUE says 'the prize is not in BLUE'. GREEN says 'the prize is not in RED'. Which box contains the prize? Reply only RED, BLUE, or GREEN.
Evaluate (true AND false) OR ((NOT false) AND true). Reply exactly TRUE or FALSE.
Return only a JSON object with exactly two keys: count with integer value 3, and colors with the ordered list amber, violet, cyan. Do not use Markdown fences.
Rows: A has quantity 3; B has quantity 1; C has quantity 4. Return only JSON {"ids":[...]} listing IDs with quantity at least 3 in row order.
Return only a JSON object with exactly the key message. Its value must be the text line1, then a newline character, then line2. Encode the newline correctly in JSON.
Sort 7, -2, 11, 0 numerically ascending. Return only a JSON array of integers.
Output exactly cobalt|birch|7 and nothing else.
Select the last word in this list: ivory falcon cedar. Reply with only that lowercase word, without punctuation.
Select only the capitalized words from: Apple pear Birch plum Cedar. Preserve order and join with commas without spaces. Output nothing else.
Reverse the characters NEBULA. Reply only with the reversed uppercase string.

Registry:
R17 | north | VELA
R23 | south | ORBIT
R31 | east | LYRA
What is the code for R23? Reply only with that code.

Shipment manifest:
P-12: 2.50 kg
P-42: 4.75 kg
P-81: 6.00 kg
What is the mass of P-42 in kg? Reply only with the decimal number exactly as written.

Revision log: Revision 1 sets the project codename to EMBER. Revision 2 replaces that codename with SABLE. Revision 3 changes only the launch month, leaving the codename unchanged. What is the latest codename? Reply only with the uppercase codename.
Organization facts: Mira reports to Oren. Oren reports to Tala. Juno reports to Mira. Who is the manager of Mira's manager? Reply only with the name.

Without executing code, determine what this Python 3 code prints. Reply only with the output.
n = 1
for _ in range(4):
    n = n * 2 + 1
print(n)

Without executing code, determine what this Python 3 code prints. Reply only with the output.
s = 'orbit'
print(s[1:4].upper())

Without executing code, determine what this Python 3 code prints. Reply only with the integer.
xs = [3, 1, 3, 2]
print(sum(set(xs)))

Without executing code, determine what this Python 3 code prints. Reply only with the integer.
def f(x):
    return x*x - 2*x
print(f(5) - f(2))

protocol.selection_algorithm: sort IDs; random.Random(seed).sample if bounded; sort selected IDs

sampling.seed_behavior: selection seed only; API seed omitted

protocol.request_isolation: one fresh chat per task and repeat; externally managed endpoint; no model loading/unloading
protocol.truncation_policy: finish_reason length is scored incorrect; transport errors are unscored and counted separately

results.diagnostic: Request exceeded its wall-clock deadline; endpoint cancellation is unverified and no later tasks were sent.

interpretation: Rule-scored capability task accuracy, not IQ. Public tasks may be contaminated; scores are not equivalent to official leaderboard harnesses.

wilson_95.scope: first repeat of distinct items only
wilson_95.assumption: descriptive binomial approximation; tasks may be correlated and are not a representative intelligence sample

summary.repeat_interpretation: Repeated responses are dependent observations of the same items, not additional independent questions.

collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

memory.note: Module count does not establish active memory channels. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; bandwidth has not been benchmarked.

pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

measurement_scope.power_boundary: selected GPU and whole-client CPU/RAM; other workloads may contribute

collection.policy: Read-only allow-listed OS/driver probes without elevation; no unique device IDs, host names, network addresses or user paths.

memory.note: Module count does not establish active memory channels. Clocks are firmware/OS reports; bandwidth has not been benchmarked.

pcie.note: Snapshot may show an idle downshift. Reported maxima can reflect platform limits. Encoding ceiling excludes packet/system overhead and is not measured transfer bandwidth.

capabilities.note: No FLOPS/TOPS or device-memory bandwidth measurement was performed. Model quantization bit width is not hardware arithmetic precision; peak compute also depends on operation, clock and sparsity.

history.note: Whole-client CPU/RAM and selected GPU; not inference-process isolation. GPU values hold the last driver snapshot only while fresh. CPU temperature is absent without a supported actual sensor. Means/peaks in summary preserve all observations despite ring eviction.

summary.drift_note: Early/late windows can overlap on runs shorter than 120 seconds. Differences describe observed workloads/environment; they do not establish thermal throttling, sustained model speed or hardware capability.
summary.coverage_note: Time-weighted coverage excludes gaps longer than four sampling intervals or one second, whichever is larger. Peaks are maxima of observed samples, not guaranteed physical peaks. Ring eviction does not change all-run aggregates.

notes: Implementation validation: the endpoint timed out on the first question. No capability score was obtained. This is not a clean model-quality comparison.
